veranderings.blok: Waar water vries en weer smelt
veranderings.rede: The adverb 'daarbo' (up there) is written as one word under the AWS.

veranderings.blok: Die siklus begin van voor af
veranderings.voor: In hierdie stappe van die siklus
veranderings.na: By hierdie stappe van die siklus
veranderings.rede: The opening block says 'By sommige stappe'; using the same preposition for the same steps reads more consistently and naturally.

veranderings.voor: Dieselfde water se pad tussen die see, die lug en die land.
veranderings.na: Die pad wat dieselfde water tussen die see, die lug en die land loop.
veranderings.rede: The possessive 'Dieselfde water se pad' is stiff for a definition; a relative clause reads more naturally with the same meaning.

veranderings.voor: Die krag wat alles na die aarde toe aftrek.
veranderings.na: Die krag wat alles na die aarde toe trek.
veranderings.rede: 'na ... toe' already gives the direction, so 'aftrek' doubles it; 'na die aarde toe trek' is the idiomatic form.
